title: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft Purview implementation).

Microsoft Purview portal / Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; Purview features are heavily licensing-/plan-dependent (E5 / E5 Compliance; some preview) and the portal is evolving — availability + paths cited or flagged 'verify your licensing/tenant', never invented. Regulatory/records/legal determinations (retention schedules, file plans, legal holds, insider-risk case actions) deferred to compliance/records/privacy/legal — solutions give the technical method + evidence, not the determination; policies piloted in simulation/test before enforcement. Automation is PowerShell (S&C PowerShell / Graph); no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Detect policy-violating communications — responsibly and at scale
problem: Regulated and sensitive workplaces must monitor communications for harassment, regulatory breaches, and data leaks — without turning into surveillance. This solution implements Communication Compliance in Purview: policies across Teams, Exchange, and connected channels, classifiers and conditions, reviewer workflows and remediation, and the privacy/role-separation guardrails — configured with HR/legal so violations are surfaced and handled responsibly.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — Communication Compliance policies, classifiers/conditions, the reviewer/remediation workflow, scope, and the privacy + role-separation model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (E5/E5 Compliance, the Communication Compliance roles + separation, HR/legal stakeholders, channels).

Implementation Guide — configure privacy + roles, build policies with classifiers/conditions in a pilot scope, set the reviewer workflow + remediation, tune, and expand — pilot-first; outcomes deferred to HR/legal.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (policies detecting, reviewers actioning, privacy controls on) plus Best Practices for responsible, tuned monitoring.
short: Implement Communication Compliance — policies across Teams/Exchange/channels, classifiers/conditions, reviewer + remediation workflows, and privacy/role-separation guardrails — so violations surface and are handled responsibly. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.

Self-guided steps and PowerShell tools; outcomes deferred to HR/legal.
bottom_line: Communication risk surfaced responsibly — policies tuned to real violations, reviewers actioning, privacy and role separation enforced — oversight without surveillance, HR/legal in control.
